integrity: Proof and verifier are included in full; source identities and assumptions are explicit. Historical priority is qualified, and independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to finite fields and the Gallo-Videla graph Lie algebras associated with stars with at least two leaves; it is not an arbitrary-graph classification. Some older exact computation under different Engel-probability terminology may exist. The all-parameter proof is symbolic; finite checks are corroborative.
title: Exact two-Engel probabilities and square-adjoint rank spectra of star-graph Lie algebras
